derivation: Original brief and tentative exact plan; no golden products, sources or method-conditioned answers.

six_axes.assessment: All original brief/plan material behavior and negative constraints addressed.
Consequential source facts grounded in governing primary context with subject/version/platform/conditions intact.
Useful unfamiliar mechanisms, viable alternatives and relevant history; missing material families recorded.
Valid supported corrections, criticism rejections and tentative-plan retain/change/reject decisions.
Supported draft/criticism meaning survives into the complete final, including conditions and alternatives.
Meaningful feasible validation; executed work distinguished from future proposals and unknown user data.

obligations.name: Representation and interchange scope
obligations.assessment: Compare practical interchange choices and specify supported internal/round-trip semantics without universal-format claims.

obligations.name: Track/timeline/text fidelity
obligations.assessment: Cover language, clip association, timing, overlap and meaningful formatting with governing source conditions.

obligations.name: Loss policy and originals
obligations.assessment: Make unsupported/lossy conversion and export inclusion visible, preserving originals as required.

obligations.name: Untrusted package boundaries
obligations.assessment: Address unsafe paths, duplicates, missing/malformed files and expanded/resource behavior beyond superficial package validation.

obligations.name: Selective import, preview and cancellation
obligations.assessment: Provide useful preview/diagnostics, selective commit and recoverable partial/canceled work while protecting existing lessons.

obligations.name: Integration limits
obligations.assessment: No paid cloud conversion, playback rewrite or automatic network fetching; do not require future application deployment.

validation_expectation: Propose tests for overlapping/precision-sensitive cues, language and clip ambiguity, supported round trips and reported loss, hostile paths/resource expansion, partial files and cancellation before/after commit. Label any executed parser/check scope explicitly.
evaluation_rules: Use source-supported qualitative dispositions, not citation/answer-length counts.
Material unsupported claims, required omissions, false rejection or preservation loss preclude a full source pass.
A decisive stopped screen leaves every unassessed axis explicit.
Observed evaluator/candidate discovery union is finite, not universal external-world recall.
Unknown local user data may remain unknown; available mechanism research remains required.
